findings.summary: The prepared 8.7.2 surfaces close the prior version-surface mismatch, but the packet does not contain completed release-quality verification bound to the final candidate 737b874260e3063d9d586c669c8069622b4de1ea.
evidence: The authoritative packet identifies 737b874260e3063d9d586c669c8069622b4de1ea as the target and final reviewed candidate.
charness-artifacts/release/latest.md explicitly says “quality unestablished: pytest-release pending final resume.”

The only supplied full release-quality receipt is charness-artifacts/release/8.7.1-prepush-quality.json, which verifies head 5d4d59eff391eadecc079e9099432c308c4b4071 and therefore cannot prove the 8.7.2 candidate.

charness-artifacts/critique/v872-release-critique.md reports a full quality run on committed tree 23dc82206dd5f18fdc4524f55ad48286b63f5820, which predates both the prepared 8.7.2 commit 53e61b8344b2b0b8ac83db5959fa864a8e1f5813 and final packet target 737b874260e3063d9d586c669c8069622b4de1ea.

The 8.7.2 claims review correctly binds the prepared record at 53e61b8344b2b0b8ac83db5959fa864a8e1f5813, but it expressly treats code correctness as out of scope and does not supply the missing final-candidate quality receipt.
findings.action: Run the mandatory final-resume release-quality verification on the exact publish candidate, retain an identity-bound passing receipt, and rebind or regenerate the approval packet if that run changes the candidate.

counterweight_triage.concern: The prior release-version-surface-mismatch finding remains open.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The packet now includes consistent 8.7.2 marketplace and packaging versions, an 8.7.2 prepared release record, a stated patch rationale, and a passing claims review bound to prepared commit 53e61b8344b2b0b8ac83db5959fa864a8e1f5813.

counterweight_triage.concern: The #815 implementation itself lacks any verification.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The critique artifact records focused tests and a full release-quality run on 23dc82206dd5f18fdc4524f55ad48286b63f5820, so the original code slice has meaningful evidence; however, that evidence is not bound to the final 8.7.2 candidate and cannot complete release approval.

counterweight_triage.concern: The prepared claims review is insufficient because it predates the commit carrying its own review artifacts.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Binding the claims review to the prepared release record is coherent for the prepare/resume workflow; the blocker is the explicitly pending final-resume quality proof, not merely that the claims artifact was committed later.

next_move: Do not approve publication yet. Complete final-resume release quality on the exact 8.7.2 publish candidate and provide its bound passing receipt; the two prior procedural findings are otherwise narrowed to this single remaining proof gap.
non_claims: This review does not claim the #815 implementation is incorrect.
This review does not treat the prior 8.7.1 observer or quality artifacts as 8.7.2 proof.
This review judges only the inline identity-bound semantic payload and does not infer current workspace state.
